caption: The drawing depicts a female doll figure with pale skin, blonde hair styled in curls, and a black headband. The doll is dressed in a large, full-skirted dress with a light blue and white plaid pattern that has thin lines of gold and beige. The dress features puffed short sleeves and a fitted bodice with a slightly off-the-shoulder neckline decorated with a thin frill. Under the main skirt, a light beige or peach-colored underskirt is visible. The doll has red ankle boots and is positioned with her arms slightly outward. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a head-and-shoulders inset view of the doll from the back, showing the hairstyle and headband from behind, and a ruffled blue detail at the neckline. The background is plain and off-white. The artist's signature and location, "Edith Towns, Rome, 1840," appear in the lower right corner.
title: Doll - "Nellie Bates"
